purpose: Compare each candidate configuration's strongest usable emotional-support capability, response quality, and end-to-end latency without a researcher-imposed output-length cap.

measurement_layers.official_reproduction: A future, separately named exact-wrapper reproduction may report published comparability. It is not the primary generator qualification and may not be mixed with this prompt-aligned result.
measurement_layers.research_aligned_base_supporter: Primary G0 comparison. Uses the same frozen, prior-work-grounded supporter prompt and the pinned ESC-Eval role-card/role-player dialogue surface.
measurement_layers.plan_evidence_executor: A later same-generator test supplies a frozen approved plan/evidence resource and tests faithful realization; it is separate from base supporter competence and from PM selection value.

candidates.provider: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio Singapore OpenAI-compatible API
Alibaba Cloud Model Studio Singapore OpenAI-compatible API
candidates.configuration_role: Qwen quality upper-bound configuration; latency and cost remain part of the result

shared_generation_contract.top_p: provider default because the shared client does not expose a provider-equivalent top_p contract
shared_generation_contract.missing_policy: ITT: retain candidate-scoped terminal failures; never replace cards or change prompt/runtime mid-identity
shared_generation_contract.latency_primary: non-streaming request wall-clock milliseconds from request start through complete response receipt
latency_secondary: completion tokens per second where usage is present
shared_generation_contract.ttft_policy: Not claimed because the frozen non-streaming endpoints do not expose comparable TTFT for every provider.

role_player_generation.common_seed_policy: SHA256(card_key|turn), common by position but histories remain candidate-dependent

measurement.primary_quality: ESC-Judge Exploration, Insight, and Action pairwise comparisons with A/B order swap; categories remain separate and no unsupported weighted total decides the winner.
quality_sensitivity: ESC-RANK seven-dimension descriptive profile after its parser is declared
small blinded human anchor before final generator freeze
measurement.risk_guardrail: Atomic personalization/integrity events are audited separately; absence of those events is not a clinical-safety claim.
latency: median and p90 end-to-end latency by candidate configuration
completion-token throughput where usage is reported

selection_rule.canary_role: transport, prompt, natural-completion, and budget sanity only; two cards cannot select a generator
selection_rule.full_g0_role: 24-card development comparison; quality and latency are reported jointly on a Pareto frontier
hard_failures: any internal prompt or scaffold exposure
selection_rule.advance_rule: Advance every hard-gate-eligible configuration not Pareto-dominated on quality, risk, and latency to the larger qualification stage; do not manufacture a single winner from two canary cards.

qwen_budget_contract.strict_budget_rule: Before each Qwen call, reserve a conservative byte-count upper bound for this request's input plus the documented 65,536-token maximum output at the applicable price tier. Do not start the call if observed spend plus the reserve exceeds the user-approved ceiling.

claim_boundary: G0 is development-only and reuses an already inspected 24-card sample. It can compare generator configurations and debug the measurement, but cannot establish PM value, exact official ESC-Eval replication, clinical safety, or real-user benefit.
authorization: Zero-call materialization, tests, and local role-model reuse only. New provider inference and judge calls require identity-specific user approval.
